title.zh: IMF Approves $139 Million for El Salvador After Waiver for Bitcoin Breach
title.en: IMF Approves $139 Million for El Salvador After Waiver for Bitcoin Breach

current_state.zh: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility after waiving the government's breach of program restrictions on Bitcoin accumulation, while reiterating demands that El Salvador halt further BTC purchases and fully transfer the state-run Chivo wallet exposure to the private sector.
